title: QSOL UFF v5.2.0: Machine-Checked Assurance and Formal Claim Boundaries for Reproducible Astrophysics
description:
QSOL UFF v5.2.0 is an additive formal-assurance release of the reproducible astrophysics and falsification laboratory. It retains the v5.1.0 scientific implementation and defense-in-depth workflow while adding a Lean 4 specification of selected invariants around assurance ordering, replay, experiment identity, transaction closure, one-way observation, telemetry authority, and manifest construction.

The Lean layer is audited for proof holes and project-defined axioms, pins its toolchain, maintains an exact theorem manifest, and runs an explicit axiom-dependency audit.

Scientific boundary: machine-checked software invariants do not prove SHA-256 security, catalogue correctness, null-model adequacy, statistical independence, causality, or physical truth. The governing rule remains REPLAY_VERIFIED != ENSEMBLE_CALIBRATED != PHYSICAL_TRUTH.
